The death of Erastes throws the underworld, and Rome's river commerce into chaos, and Pullo and Vorenus step into the gap. Octavian and Anthony begin a long and bitter rivalry with a dispute over Caesar's will and sharing of power.

3.t: These Being the Words of Marcus Tullius Cicero
3.o: Brutus and Cassius struggle to raise foreign armies to oppose the Cesarean party. Mark Antony's plans to change his post-consul proconsular governorship from Macedonia to Gaul are derailed when Cicero delivers an in-absentia message to the Senate, and throws his support behind Octavian. Vorenus struggles to contain an all-out gang war in the Aventine Collegium, of his own making, that he blames on Pullo. In the house of the Julii, Octavia passes the hours in a drug induced daze, while a duplicitous youth named Duro, planted amongst the Julii by Servilia, looks for the chance to set a deadly pl

4.t: Testudo et Lepus (The Tortoise and the Hare)
4.o: Pullo races to find Vorenus with news of his family's fate. Servilia's plans to eliminate a rival exact a high price from her. Cicero is astonished when Octavian sends word that his victorious legions are coming home to Rome. In Rome, Timon finally grows weary of Atia's bidding.

5.o: Despite Pullo's advice, Vorenus and his family return to the Collegium with his family who is reunited, and cleansed of their ordeal. Octavian is denied a triumph and urges Cicero to endorse his bid to be made Consul in exchange for an agreement to allow Cicero to veto his actions. Octavian takes both Cicero and the Senate by surprise with his first Consular act. Vorenus attempts' to make peace with Memmio and Cotta create suspicions that he has gone soft.

6.o: Vorenus receives orders to plunge Rome into a bloodbath the likes that have not been seen since the dictatorship of Sulla. Octavia reveals her secret to Atia, and the armies of the Liberators and the Caesarians clash for the last time, with the fate of Republic in the balance.

7.o: Antony's nature reasserts itself, and challenges his alliance with Octavian. Timon and Levi set themselves against Herod's plans. Servilia's public displays of grief leave Atia unsettled. Gaia uses Pullo's punishment as a weapon against him. His daughter's sudden interest in business matters arouses Vorenus' suspicions. Posca gets married.

8.o: Octavian proclaims a new era of virtue in Rome, a program that his family and subordinates find impossible to obey. Vorenus is sent on a mission after a missing shipment of gold to discover who mysteriously hijacked it on its way to the Roman treasury. Pullo's loss and rage are channeled against Memmio, Omnipor and their henchmen. Octavian pursues Livia as an "appropriate" bride, and issues Mark Antony an ultimatum he knows he can't refuse.

9.t: Deus Impeditio Esuritori Nullus (No God Can Stop a Hungry Man)
9.o: The people of Rome are starving. There have been many grain shortages over the past few months, but things have gotten particularly bad. In hopes of keeping the people from openly rebelling, Octavian sends Atia and Octavia to Alexandria in order to negotiate a deal with Mark Antony, though his real reasons for their trip is soon revealed. Meanwhile, Titus Pullo and Lucius Vorenus must try to keep the peace amongst many of the mercenaries who are in Rome.

10.o: Following his naval defeat at Actium, Marc Antony returns to Egypt, where he and Cleopatra settle into a world of debauchery. Octavian tries to use Pullo as leverage to Vorenus to gain acess to the palace, but Vorenus stays loyal to Antony. Finally, it is Cleopatra who dupes Antony, saving her own life by sacrificing her honor. Ceasar Augustus triumphs in Rome.

1.o: "In the middle of a June night in 1993, a young woman slices off her husband's penis in a seeming fit of rage. John and Lorena Bobbitt's dueling versions of the attack explode into the worldwide media and spill into the courtroom. The nation takes sides as a renewed battle of the sexes feeds a ravenous 24-hour TV news cycle."

2.o: "Acquitted of rape, John became a celebrity while Lorena stood trial, facing decades in prison. TV cameras recorded her ordeal as prosecutors attacked her relentlessly-a jealous shrew, a liar and thief. But though John proved a poor witness, and her lawyers demonstrated years of domestic abuse, it looked doubtful that they could prove she was legally insane the night she cut off his penis."

3.o: "As Lorena's trial resumed, all agreed she had been abused. But was she legally insane when she attacked John? Millions stayed glued to their TVs as her testimony reached the fateful night she lost all control. Her lawyers had to prove she was under the influence of an "irresistible impulse," a defense that rarely worked. As momentum seemed to swing against her, a surprise witness took the stand."

4.o: "Millions of TV viewers sat glued to their sets to see what fate Lorena would meet. Would she be found guilty and deported? Found not guilty and have the opportunity to rebuild? John and Lorena would set out on wildly different paths-- John chased fame in a self-destructive downward spiral, while Lorena had to come to grips with the scars of her ordeal, no matter the verdict."

1.o: Tariq is an off-duty officer. His wife died in an accident, however he imagines her with him everyday. He returns to work to investigate the kidnapping of Sama on the hands of Qabeel, who published a picture of her tied up and threatened to kill her. Tariq suspects her ex-boyfriend, Akram.

Tariq meets Sama’s ghost in the bathroom and it gives him some clues. Qabeel publishes an image of a new victim.

3.o: Qabeel’s latest victim is Adam, a psychiatrist. When Tariq is looking for clues in his clinic, he meets with his ghost. Adam was cheating on his wife. Abdul Rahman discovers a person named Saied who was Adam’s patient and Sama’s colleague, when they go to interrogate him, he runs away.

4.o: Abdul Rahman finds a connection between Sama and Adam. Saied’s accident appears to be related to the crimes. Adam’s leaked papers may have got him killed. Saied’s ghost appears to Tariq and talks to him.

5.o: Qabeel kills Adam. Another officer joins the case with Tariq. Adam’s ghost appears to Tariq. Tariq finds some of Adam’s former friends, but reaches nothing. Tariq believes that he has found the killer, but it was just a young man trying to show off. Tariq chases Hamza to avenge his wife’s murder.

6.o: Mai tells Tariq that she is going to file for Khulʿ from Alaa.  Hamza disappears. Adel tells Tariq that he has nothing to do with the disappearance. Qabeel kidnaps Hamza and his wife Shaimaa. Abdul Rahman finds Tariq’s phone in Hamza’s house. Farid sends two men to threaten Tariq.

7.o: Tariq breaks up with Mai. He sees Sama’s ghost one more time. Hamza’s family reports Tariq. Tariq goes to an apartment and finds human organs dealers. Qabeel kills Hamza and Shaimaa. Hamza’s ghost appears to Tariq and tells him he is crazy. Qabeel sends Tariq a message.

8.o: Tariq suspects that the two victims didn’t die. When he goes to Hamza’s house he finds a threatening letter and sees Shaimaa’s ghost. Their dead bodies appear afterwards on the road confirming their death. Tariq keeps seeing ghosts until he passes out. Qabeel kidnaps a new victim.

9.o: Qabeel posts about a new victim, Fuad, who is a corrupt lawyer. They get the IP of where Qabeel published the post, and through cameras they see a man on a wheelchair going in and out of a cyber cafe, and at the graveyard they learn there’s a wheel-chaired man also visits a certain grave daily.

10.o: Tariq finds Fuad hidden in Samer’s father tomb, and after arresting Samer he realizes he’s not Qabeel, and that he was avenging his father’s death caused by Fuad. Qabeel kidnaps a new victim.

11.o: Qabeel’s new victim is Raouf. Tariq applies a new tactic, to make Qabeel slip and he can catch him. A’laa kidnapped his son from Mai, and Tariq tries to meddle, with no luck. Raouf tries to escape, but Qabeel catches up with him, and torments him.

12.o: Qabeel announces going live on Facebook; he shoots Raouf during the broadcast, and Tariq still couldn’t catch him. Tariq links between Salma and Raouf, but she doesn’t admit knowing him. Both Tariq and Abdul Rahman are under interrogation.

13.o: After interrogation, Tariq gets moved to a far city. He realizes that Salma did know Raouf and confronts her that she was cheating on Adam with Raouf. He questions Akram again, and learns that Sama was a drug addict. Adel charges Tariq with Hamza’s murder.

14.o: Tariq eludes the police and is on the run. He later meets with Abdul Rahman, and admits to him all the nightmares and hallucinations he sees. Qabeel posts Sama’s late mother’s photo, who's been missing for 20 years, not dead. Abdul Rahman finds out Adam was gambling and losing to Khalid Al-Masry.

15.o: Adel finds a threat letter to Hamza inside Tariq’s car, and later a video recording places Tariq next to Hamza’s villa. Tariq searches for Shahi, who was chatting with Khalid Al-Masry, and finally finds her.

16.o: Tariq learns that Adam is Qabeel. We see Adam & Sama together at his friend’s, Rami. Tariq’s accusations spread over the news. Tariq warns Salma she could be Adam’s next victim, and she does find him waiting for her at home; she texts Tariq for help.

17.o: When Tariq arrives at Salma’s, he finds her dead, and gets charged for her death as Qabeel. Tariq later sees her, and she scolds him for her death. Adam kills Rami, and thought Sama was dead too, for overdosing on drugs; she appears to be alive when he was burying her.

18.o: Tariq questions Adam’s dad at the hospital, when he secretly calls the police, but he leaves before they come. Adam and Sama move to Alexandria, and he calls his friend Omar to meet. Tariq follows a dead lead to Al-Faiyum.

19.o: Adam asks Omar to forge 2 passports for him and Sama. Tariq reaches Alexandria in search for Adam, and starts his solo investigations around. Sama recalls awful memories of her step-mother, and her manager.

20.o: Adel and Abdul Rahman find a corpse of a lady at the grave. Tariq learns that Adam is back to doing drugs. Sama has a fight with the building’s doorman, and Adam sets him up as payback.

21.o: Tariq asks a realtor about Adam. He sees Hamza again and he keeps mocking him. Sama flirts with Omar, and Adam persuades her to marry him so they can legally rent an apartment. Adel and Abdul Rahman find out some details about the corpse.

22.o: Tariq learns that Adam’s in close vicinity to him. Adam recalls finding out about Salma’s betrayal with Raouf, and goes to score some drugs from Bedouin dealers, whom Tariq later finds his way to them, and finds himself in a trap.

23.o: Sara’s spirit appears to Tariq while he’s with Mai; he reaches a drug dealer that Adam scored from him. Adam recalls his story with Shaimaa. Adel finds out what happened to Sherifa El-Abd, and Sama recalls how she lost her. Tariq asks Abdul Rahman for info about Omar.

24.o: Mousa’s arrested, and he confessed his crime. Tariq questions Omar about Adam, who pretends he knows nothing about him. Sama & Adam work on hacking into Tariq’s phone to know all about him.

25.o: While Mai confronts Tariq with how critical his condition is, Sama posts photos for her son as their next victim; so both her & Tariq decide to head to Cairo to save the boy.  Adam recalls his deal with Sama & Shaimaa to make every one who hurt them before pay for it.

26.o: Tariq told Omar that Adam’s murderer. Safeya found out that Sama’s doing drugs, and talks to her from the heart to stop this. Tariq found out his phone was hacked, which he decided to use to his benefit. Omar told Adam and Sama that he won’t help them, and they must leave.

27.o: Tariq led Adam to a trap and almost captured him, but he escaped in a blink. Sama tried to persuade Omar to help them with the passports as Adam instructed her, while he on the other hand had kidnapped Safeya as he knew Omar wouldn’t help them.

28.o: Adam recalls how he murdered Shaimaa, as he informed Omar he’s got his mother, in return for the passports. Tariq learned that Omar forged passports for Adam and another person, so he stole his phone, and texted Adam to go meet him; Adam went to trap Tariq; Abdul Rahman came to his rescue.

29.o: Adel & Abdul Rahman were questioning Omar when they received a call about Tariq so they left him. Tariq told Mai to say that he kidnapped her. Sama found Safeya unconscious, and took her to a hospital, while Adam killed Omar. Tariq  went to question Safeya, but Adam beat him to her.

30.o: Adam killed Omar's mother. Abdul Rahman found Adam & Sama’s photos for passports. Tariq found Adam’s whereabouts. Sama planned to get back at Adam after what he did, so she took his money, and burned his forged passport, and fled. Tariq drowned Adam, after Adam shot him twice.

1.o:
Four years after the events in Manscheid, Luc Capitani is working as a handyman in the station district of Luxembourg City.

Until Bianca, a prostitute, hires him to investigate the disappearance of her friend Andrea. The search is cut short when Capitani locates her body in a forest, and the hunt for her killer begins. Meanwhile, Lucky Onu arrives in Luxembourg from Nigeria, to look for his sister.

2.o:
Capitani is hired by Valentina Draga to look after her "girls". Lucky locates his sister, who wants nothing to do with him.

Police officer Elsa Ley is monitoring drug traffic in the area, but the relationship between her and Luc has deteriorated. A second prostitute is murdered in the night.

3.o:
Capitani reveals he is working as an undercover police officer for Pascale Cojocaru, which enabled him to walk free from prison.

Luc and Elsa share information on the murders. Bianca informs Luc of underage prostitutes working at a cabaret club in the city. Lucky struggles to get hold of his sister.

4.o:
Gibbes Koenig joins forces with Valentina to combat a Nigerian drug gang.

Luc tries to organise a coup, but needs Elsa's help, but Elsa calls him a crook and refuses to work with him.  Luc's relationship with his boss Cojocaru starts to collapse.

5.o:
Capitani helps Lucky view the body of his sister in return for information on the drug operations around Luxembourg City station.

Toni is mistrustful of Luc and forbids Bianca from spending time with him, but agrees to accompany Luc on a trip to the forest to meet with a dealer.

6.o:
Luc discovers his former lover Carla Pereira is supplying the Nigerians with drugs. She asks him to leave her alone.

Elsa and Toni spend the night together but try to continue working together. Luc seeks assistance from his sister Jeanne, but the siblings' relationship has been rocky since the death of their father. Pascale Cojocaru realises that something is hindering Luc's release.

7.o:
Capitani organises an attack on a Nigerian mafia drug shipment.

Cojucaru promises Luc his freedom if the operation is successful and if Arthur is taken into custody. Luc forces Carla to participate in the attack. Lucky asks Bianca for help finding Grace. Elsa suspects that Luc is working undercover.

8.o:
Arthur is found dead, while the drug shipment has disappeared.

Lucky is imprisoned by Queen as he represents a risk to the operation. Valentina forces Gibbes to withdraw from the business. Cojucaru is unsuccessful in securing Luc's full release, although he has earned her trust. Luc decides to work for Valentina.

9.o:
Elsa and Luc suspect that Carla is behind the drug shipment's disappearance.

Protesting her innocence, Carla reveals significant information about drug dealings at the "Grand Huit" café, which Luc passes on to Elsa. Grace tells Bianca that Dominik tried to kill her. Bianca demands an explanation from Dominik.

10.o:
Valentina takes over Gibbes' business, and thanks Luc for sorting the problem with the Nigerian dealer.

Elsa observes that the drug traffic is continuing to operate. Bianca wonders where her former friends are getting their cash flow from. An injured Lucky seeks to return to the city. Luc and Elsa talk for the first time.

11.t: Wipe the Smile From Your Face
11.o:
Cojocaru locates Luc's service weapon in Manscheid lake and returns it to him.

Luc must confront his inner turmoil. Elsa and Toni monitor the prostitutes at the station, but Toni seems to have other plans in mind. Luc takes Lucky in, and Bianca finds Grace's address.

12.o:
Luc discovers that Dominik stole the drug shipment and has been selling them via the prostitutes.

7.o: Gigi invites Harper to her annual tea party and Alex gets mad when she accepts. Alex learns that Gigi plans to embarrass Harper so she uses her magic to get back at Gigi.

8.o: Justin learns that his new pet beagle is actually a magical dragon. To his dismay, someone else claims the "dog" and enters it in a local canine competition.

9.o: Justin does not let Alex into an R-Rated movie, so she uses magic to get in. However, she may accidentally get into the film, too.

10.t: Pop Me and We Both Go Down
10.o: Justin gets a zit before his prom date with a junior, and to make matters worse, Alex accidentally animates it.

11.o: Justin has some competition from a popular classmate when he wants to be chosen for the World School Summit at the U.N. Meanwhile, Alex becomes in love with herself due to a potion.

12.o: Alex hates being compared to her older brother, Justin, so she asks a genie to remove the resemblences.

13.o: Alex and Justin go to a summer school for wizards and Alex has a hard time fitting in. Back at home, Jerry and Max try to prove their manhood.

14.o: Alex may have her chance to shine when she finds out Dr.Evalinie's plan to take away Justin's powers during a tournament at the school.

15.o: Justin casts a spell on himself to impress a girl, and ends up being the baseball team's star pitcher. When Alex finds out, she uses it to become the catcher's "good luck charm".

16.o: When Jerry's fun-loving brother comes for a visit, Alex tries to get him to be her magic teacher instead of her strict dad.

17.o: When Alex gets an F on her wizarding report card, she does her best to keep it a secret. But hiding the truth becomes a problem when her powers are taken away from her for turning her parents into guinea pigs.

18.o: Alex takes on an internship with a top Fashion Magazine and decides to put on an outrageous fashion show featuring Harper's bizarre wear to teach her boss a lesson for taking credit for her ideas. Jerry and Theresa hire a new girl, Millie, at the Sub Station that Justin immediately falls in love with so Max tries to help.

19.o: Alex makes a mannequin come to life and goes out with him, in order to make Riley jealous. Meanwhile, Jerry and Theresa go out of town and leave Justin in charge of the household.

20.o: It is Alex's 15th birthday and she uses the switching spell to avoid being in her Quinceanera. Justin and Max have to learn how to dance for Alex's party.

21.o: Alex wants an easier way to complete her Art History assignment, so she brings historical masterpieces to life to help her complete her worksheet. Meanwhile, Jerry and Max use a spell to play football in the house, which turns out badly.

1.o: Alex and Harper enter an academic competition, but Alex wears "smarty pants" that give her all of the answers. At first it's great, but Alex soon realizes that her cheating doesn't allow Harper to shine. Meanwhile, Max tries to con everybody at school into buying his water bottles.

2.o: Justin falls for a new girl who is a werewolf and turns him into one, too; Max starts a dog-walking business with a new friend.

3.o: Justin and Max steal Alex's diary only to have it stolen again by Gigi, Alex's arch nemesis. In an attempt to recover the diary, the brothers accidentally place Gigi inside the book and into Alex's secret fairy-tale princess world.

4.o: Alex uses the restoration and upcoming race of Jerry's junky old car as an opportunity to develop her relationship with her "gear head" crush, Dean. Meanwhile, Max orders a mind-reading kit.

5.o: The kids fail at their group magic project, so Jerry devises a plan that will force them to work together. Now Alex must wrestle with sacrificing her first one-on-one date with Dean so that she and Justin can help Max's superhero, "Maximan," solve the crime and prove to Jerry that the siblings can work as a team.

6.o: Wiz Tech is forced to close, and the Russo's must take in Professor Crumbs and fellow student Ronald, who quickly develops a magical connection with Alex. Max teaches Professor Crumbs how to assimilate into the mortal world and Justin saves the day by finding the solution to reopen Wiz Tech.

7.o: After enrolling in Wiz Tech, Alex realizes her new crush, Ronald, has kidnapped her former crush, Dean. Max and Professor Crumbs join forces to become a dynamic duo, and Justin and Alex must team up to save Wiz Tech from falling into the hands of Ronald and his evil father.

8.o: Alex tries to avoid running into Harper at the annual Comic-Con type convention in order to protect her wizard secret but winds up revealing the truth after Harper takes a spin in Alex’s power laden Battle Diva costume. Meanwhile, Justin and Max work alongside Hugh Normous and the Emergency Wizards to make sure other wizards don’t perform any real magic.

9.o: Alex tries to save the taxi that she was born in. Meanwhile, Justin sets out to find his birthplace.

10.o: Alex gets Cupid to help her parents after an argument, but will Cupid cause more trouble than he solves? After being hit by Cupid's arrow, Justin falls in love with Harper.

11.o: When Mr. Stuffleby, a wizard guidance counselor, informs the kids that they must have a viable profession to fall back on in the event that they don't become wizards, Max chooses to become a street magician while Alex and Justin decide to form a band. They all test their skills by hosting a Waverly After Dark performance at the Sub Station.

12.o: Alex gets the lead as Tinkerbell in the school's production of Peter Pan but doesn't want the part. So when she enlists the help of a real fairy to sub in and play the part, it causes the production to get out of control and the play is not necessarily performed in the same way as the traditional Peter Pan fairytale!

13.o: Alex helps Harper care for a famous designer's gown during fashion week, but she accidentally ruins it. In order to repair the gown, she must use magic to fix things.

14.o: When Justin invents a helping hand, Alex wears it out by getting it to do her chores.

15.o: Max makes up a disease to get out of gym class. Meanwhile, Alex finds out her art teacher is a 16-year-old girl, and turns her back. This results in art, Alex's best subject, being canceled.

16.o: Alex helps Harper care for a famous designer's gown during fashion week, but she accidentally ruins it. In order to repair the gown, she must use magic to fix things.

17.o: After skipping class, the principal places Alex in a "happy helpers" club, however she soon finds out what truly makes the helpers happy. Max's attempt to impress a girl backfires.

18.o: Alex tries to help Hugh find his birth parent's after he finds out he is adopted. Meanwhile, Max's plan to get revenge on Alex backfires.

19.t: Don't Rain on Justin's Parade - Earth
19.o: Justin decides to use magic to change the weather, but when Mother Nature finds out about it, she begins to cause weather trouble for Justin.

20.o: Alex uses a spell to switch brains with Harper, but she keeps on getting the spell wrong, including accidentally leaving Harper with no brain.

21.o: When Alex, Harper and Justin are accidentally transported into a silent movie, Justin and Harper begin to recognize a closer bond between them. Things heat up at the restaurant when Theresa and Jerry begin arguing about who has the more difficult job. To determine who's right, the two switch places.

22.o: Alex and Justin bond with Max's new tutor and scheme to get her a permanent job with the family, but the plan involves Max failing a test. In the end they relize that Max's tutor is just an elf that's why they have been bonding with her.

23.o: Alex is selected to paint the school's mural, which she is very excited about. However, after using magic to make the mural, she ends up messing up her own artistic ideas.

24.o: Alex tries to outdo Justin by giving their dad Merlin's hat, which grants unlimited wishes for his birthday. When she thinks Jerry's wishes are too simple, she takes matters into her own hands, but is unprepared for the consequences, including a visit from an alien spaceship.

25.o:
Justin wins an essay contest that allows him to go on the SS Tipton and meet London Tipton. Alex soon becomes friends with Bailey Pickett, and uses magic to bring Harper on-board. Max and Zack Martin compete against each other in many crazy challenges.

The crossover continues on The Suite Life on Deck S01E21 Double-crossed (II) and Hannah Montana S03E20 Super(stitious) Girl (III).

26.t: Wizards vs. Vampires on Waverly Place
26.o: When a vampire family opens a deli down the street, Justin falls for their daughter!

27.o: Justin's new vampire girlfriend Juliet gets the Russos to change their lifestyle by adding healthy foods and exercise. However Alex is concerned about Juliet's true intentions for Justin when she discovers that vampires like the taste of healthy blood.

28.o: After Dean moves away, Alex continues to date him by using magic to enter his dreams. When he pays her a surprise visit and the real date isn't as great as she had dreamt, she searches for a way to break up with him. Meanwhile Justin tells his vampire girlfriend Juliet that he is not allowed to go on her family camping trip.

29.o: Justin promises Juliet an unforgettable prom date. But when Alex organizes a zombie-themed anti-prom, things get out of hand when real zombies arrive. Meanwhile, Harper and Zeke go to the prom together.

30.o: Jerry and his siblings, Kelbo and Megan (Jerry revealed to the kids they have an aunt), need to retake the Wizard test that, in their teen years, determined who got to keep their powers. When Alex, Justin and Max see how competitive the contest gets, they realize the same test could eventually tear their family apart as well.

1.o: An astronaut's death sends her husband on a desperate mission to revive her using experimental technology, only to unearth her deepest secret.

2.o: A visionary CEO skirts the line between lust and legality when she creates lifelike sex robots. But is Thailand ready for her erotic revolution?

3.o: When a popular AI service commodifies the way people make merit, a monk challenges it with his own mass-market spiritual guide — until things go haywire.

4.o: In a Bangkok flooded by endless rain, a young girl joins a singing contest in a bid to move out of her shanty town and buy vaccines for a deadly illness.

1.o: Philandering Lateef discovers the perils — and perks — of juggling multiple women. His friend Shina's prayers come true sooner than expected.

2.o: Lateef is up to his usual tricks, but he can't shake the memory of the previous day. Shina's mother makes things difficult for his wife.

3.o: The friends discover the cost of their newfound wealth. Lateef accompanies Risi to visit Laide's parents, and Shina's domestic troubles get worse.

4.o: Desperate to repay his debt, Shina neglects pressing family matters. When he can't raise the funds he needs, Ihotu makes him an offer he can't refuse.

5.o: Ihotu gains even more leverage over Shina, but she agrees to grant him one request. As Lateef's lies catch up with him, he makes a stunning confession.

6.o: The business partners celebrate the success of their scheme — until they discover that Ihotu is even more dangerous than they'd ever imagined.

1.o: In Mexico, a police unit tracks down a murderer as their police commander finds a dangerous lead. A new referendum introduces big changes.

2.o: A heavy loss shakes up the Gringo Hunters as a new recruit enters the fold. A stakeout goes awry, and Temo's secrets begin to haunt Nico.

3.o: Nico takes on Temo's debt as Gloria's date takes a turn. Terry discovers terrifying news. Joaquín makes good on his deal with Father Murphy.

4.o: Nico confides in Gloria about Temo's gambling. The Gringo Hunters track a long-time criminal. Camila's first undercover case reveals hidden strings.

5.o: The crew's new undercover case goes sideways. Terry seeks shelter with an old, powerful friend. A tip leads to Temo's potential murderer.

6.o: Protests against New Tijuana erupt as Terry sets off on his own. A visit to Ortega tips Nico off. Finding Terry proves to be a fatal decision.

7.o: Nico and Gloria visit Father Murphy as Archi's search for a corrupt border patrol officer lands him in hot water. Ortega installs a new police chief.

8.o: With Archi missing, the Gringo Hunters lead a search party. Camila takes the reins on a case involving a sexual criminal. Gloria opens up to Emilio.

9.o: A new case affects Archi as a polygraph test bodes ill for Nico. A tip leads Gloria down a dark path, and threats against María and Silvia persist.

10.o: Nico fails Collado's test, and Gloria receives a promotion. As Archi faces a crisis, Nico and Gloria make a sordid discovery.

11.o: Ortega takes a witness. Nico finds out more about Ortega's past. Camila treads a fine line as the squad crashes a crypto scammer's bridal shower.

12.o: Threats rise against the Gringo Hunters. An arrest sends Cartolandia into disarray, and one last piece of the puzzle falls.

1.o: عندما يصل الشابّ البارع "هان جو وون" إلى البلدة، يُكلَّف بالتعاون مع الشرطي المتمرّد "لي دونغ سيك"، الذي تؤرّقه مأساة مروّعة من ماضيه.

2.o: يثير اكتشاف هيكل عظمي بشري مجهول الهويّة احتمالات مقلقة، بينما يُعيد "دونغ سيك" "كانغ مين جيونغ" إلى البلدة من ملهى ليلي في "سول".

3.o: تتزايد شكوك "جو وون" حول تورّط "دونغ سيك" في القضية، فيما يؤدّي ظهور هاتف نقّال يكتنفه الغموض إلى وضع "جو وون" في مأزق.

4.o: حين لا يُسفر استجواب "دونغ سيك" عن أي دليل، تكثّف الشرطة بحثها وتحرّياتها حول متجر جزارة "يو جاي آي"، ويدلي "جو وون" بتصريح مدوٍّ على الملأ.

5.o: ينشب عراك حين يحول "دونغ سيك" دون محاولة استغلال "كانغ جين موك"، فيما تتمّ مواجهة "أوه جي هون" بشأن ليلة اختفاء "مين جيونغ".

6.o: يرضخ "جو وون" لطلب "جين موك" بإجراء تحقيق غير رسمي بنفسه، فيما تتحرّك "دو هاي وون" لتكتب السطر الأخير في القضية وتحمي ابنها.

7.o: يتّخذ "بارك جيونغ جي" قرارًا صائبًا ويُقدِم عليه. أمّا الرسالة النصّية الثانية من "مين جيونغ"، فتقود "دونغ سيك" نحو مُكتشِف الحقيقة.

8.o: يصدم نبأ اعتقال القاتل البلدة بأكملها، لكنّه يرفض التحدّث إلى أحد سوى "دونغ سيك" و"جو وون"، اللذين يثيران غضبه أثناء استجوابه.

9.o: يبحث "دونغ سيك" باستماتة عن رفات أخته متعقّبًا دليلًا من مقطع فيديو قديم، في حين يعود "جو وون" و"جاي آي" بعد غياب دام ثلاثة أشهر.

10.o: يشاهد "دونغ سيك" لقطات كاميرات المراقبة، ويقتنع بأنّه اكتشف الجاني الحقيقي وراء موت القاتل، ويضع "جو وون" جهاز تعقّب على "نام سانغ باي".

11.o: يتّحد الفريق متعهّدين بالوصول إلى الحقيقة وراء جريمة القتل الأخيرة… وينتهي بهم الأمر مُشتبهين بشكل رئيسيّ في اثنين من بينهم.

12.o: تشقّ حقيقة أحداث ليلة وفاة "لي يو يون" طريقها نحو التكشّف، ويعاني "جيونغ جي" ليتذكّر ما حدث… فهل يتمكّن من ذلك؟

13.o: مع بداية اكتمال الصورة أمام المحقّقين، يزداد الوضوح في ارتباط "هان كي هوان" بالقضية، ويسأل "دونغ سيك" "جو وون" إن كان محلّ ثقة.

14.o: يستمع "دونغ سيك" خلسة إلى محادثة كاشفة للكثير من الأسرار الدفينة، وينطلق "جو وون" مدفوعًا بالإصرار والعزيمة للكشف عن حقائق أخرى.

15.o: بعد الحصول على تسجيل صوتي صادم، يعتزم "جو وون" تحقيق العدالة مهما كان الثمن، ثمّ يقوم هو و"دونغ سيك" باستجواب "لي تشانغ جين".

16.o: في أعقاب جريمة قتل مفاجئة أخرى، يتعاون "دونغ سيك" و"جو وون" للإيقاع بالمذنبين، وتطبيق العقوبات اللازمة.

1.o: يملك صغير دب قمر يتيم مهارات كثيرة قبل أن يصنع لنفسه موطنًا في أدغال الهند.

2.o: يتخطى أجدد الفيلة الواصلة إلى ميتم زامبيا للفيلة خجله ليبني رابطًا مع القطيع ويشكل عائلة جديدة.

3.o: يقاتل فرخ بطريق صغير الحجم لهزم احتمالاته ويتفوق على التحديات العديدة التي تقف بينه وبين المحيط الأطلسي.

4.o: في غابة مدغشقر البرية، تُشكل مجموعة من حيوانات الليمور غير المنظمة عائلة غير تقليدية وتتعلم حماية أفرادها.

5.o: يتعلم أخوان من الفهود فن الصيد قبل الانتقال إلى محمية حيث لم يُشاهد جنسهم فيها منذ 50 سنة.

6.o: قبل أن تنتقل إلى البرية، على صغيرة وشق أن تثبت لرعاتها من البشر أنها جاهزة للذهاب وحدها.

1.o: After provoking the full fury of Pernuru's matriarchs, a fearless Rudra seeks out an old acquaintance and sets a plan in motion to take over the clan.

2.o: A devastating blow drives Bhavani toward revenge while Rudra gathers Pernuru's outsiders and strengthens her growing challenge to its rulers.

3.o: As Rudra wins over the local villagers and expands her influence, her foothold unsettles Bhavani's clan — who begin to uncover her connection to Pernuru.

4.o: While Bhavani claims an early victory, Rudra's strategy turns the tide — unleashing bloodshed and betrayal that systematically weakens the clan's power.

5.o: As Pernuru's buried past resurfaces, an explosive clash erupts when Rudra joins forces with rebel men to dismantle Bhavani's authority and legacy.
